name: Band Internal Rotation
steps: Anchor a light resistance band at elbow height and stand sideways with your working arm closer to the anchor.
Bend your working elbow to 90 degrees, tuck it snugly against your ribs, and step away slightly to tension the band.
Rotate your forearm smoothly inward across your abdomen while keeping your elbow pinned to your side.
Return slowly to the starting angle without letting the band yank your arm outward, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your elbow glued to your side and rotate strictly around your shoulder joint rather than twisting your torso.
Use light tension and smooth control to isolate the subscapularis cleanly.
